events.verdict: Brown (BOS) firms up over his right foot in George's (UTA) path.
Queta (BOS) firms up in a screening position in George's (UTA) path and although George falls to the floor, it is a result of marginal contact.
Nurkic (UTA) and Queta (BOS) come together at the same spot on the floor and the leg to leg contact between the two players is incidental.
Brown (BOS) jumps from point A to point B and makes contact with Nurkic (UTA), which affects his layup attempt.
George (UTA) leans forward as Brown (BOS) moves around him in the post and George does not lose his balance as a result of any illegal contact.

Although Queta (BOS) is called for the foul, White (BOS) moves laterally into George (UTA) and affects his driving shot attempt. A foul is correctly called, but it should have been assessed to White instead of Queta.
Nurkic (UTA) is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Nurkic (UTA) and Queta (BOS) come together at the same spot on the floor and the ensuing foot to foot contact is incidental.
George (UTA) slips and falls into Brown's (BOS) path, tripping Brown.
Hauser (BOS) reaches for the ball and the marginal head contact does not affect Markkanen's (UTA) shot attempt at the rim.
White (BOS) loses control of the ball and it goes off of Nurkic's (UTA) leg. Nurkic does not intentionally kick the ball.
George (UTA) and Brown (BOS) each dive for the loose ball and the ensuing contact is incidental.
Nurkic (UTA) jumps from point A to point B and makes contact with Queta (BOS), which affects his shot attempt near the basket.
Nurkic (UTA) briefly places his hands on Pritchard (BOS) before immediately releasing away.
Pritchard (BOS) jumps forward into George (UTA) during the jump shot attempt, but any contact that occurs is marginal.
Queta (BOS) brushes Nurkic's (UTA) arm as he pursues the rebound, and the contact is marginal.

Replay review of the foul called on Brown (BOS) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Brown extends both hands into Harkless (UTA) to create space during the throw-in. Play resumes with 0.6 seconds remaining on the game clock.
After communicating with the Replay Center, it is determined that the foul originally called on Queta (BOS) occurred after the game clock expired.
